claim.statement: Anysphere's current data-use page says Privacy Mode prevents Cursor training on Customer Data and uses zero-data-retention provider agreements, subject to stated abuse-classifier exceptions; with Privacy Mode off, Cursor may store and use codebase data, prompts, editor actions and code snippets to improve and train AI features.

source.title: Cursor Data Use and Privacy Overview
source.locator: Privacy Mode enabled and disabled alternatives; last updated 15 July 2026

limitations: Privacy Mode alternatives and stated exceptions must remain visible; the claim is not a guarantee of zero processing or zero transient handling.
The current policy is not proof of the effective setting, team enforcement or provider terms for a particular 3.15 session.
unknowns: The effective Privacy Mode, team policy, model ZDR status and abuse-classifier outcome are unknown.
The data actually transmitted, stored, used for training or retained for any session are unknown.
